title: Cautious Conflict-Free Inverse Gradient Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.31855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) are indispensable tools for modeling complex phenomena in physics and engineering. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful alternative to traditional numerical solvers by directly incorporating physical constraints into neural network loss functions. Despite their advantages, PINN training requires multi-objective optimization, which often leads to significant gradient conflicts among boundary, initial, and residual loss terms. translated_title: 谨慎无冲突逆梯度方法
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）是建模物理和工程中复杂现象不可或缺的工具。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过将物理约束直接纳入神经网络的损失函数，已成为传统数值求解器的强大替代方案。尽管具有诸多优势，PINN训练需要多目标优化，这常常导致边界、初始和残差损失项之间出现显著的梯度冲突。无冲突逆梯度（ConFIG）方法能够解决这些冲突；然而，将ConFIG与Adam等自适应优化器相结合时引入了一个关键漏洞：ConFIG生成的无冲突方向会被优化器进一步处理，由此产生的权重更新相对于任务梯度而言可能不再保持无冲突特性。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了谨慎ConFIG（Cautious ConFIG），作为一种简洁的三行扩展开头被截断了。
tldr: 针对ConFIG方法与Adam等自适应优化器结合后权重更新可能丧失无冲突特性的漏洞，提出了仅需三行代码扩展的谨慎ConFIG（Cautious ConFIG）方法来保障PINN训练中更新的无冲突性。
en_tdlr: Cautious ConFIG is proposed as a concise three-line extension to address the vulnerability that arises when integrating ConFIG with adaptive optimizers like Adam, ensuring that the resulting weight updates remain conflict-free with respect to task gradients in PINN training.
